title: Figure 21: Three-Dimensional Cloaking – ray trajectories around hidden interior
description: Two 3D renderings, A and B, of wireframe spheres in which bundles of red light rays bend around a purple lens-shaped hidden object. In B some rays loop around inside before exiting. The caption reads "Figure 21. Three-Dimensional Cloaking" and explains that "A: Rays are bent around the invisible region. B: In three dimensions, some rays turn out to perform two loops in hyperspace."
